title: tc-experiment-card
description: An A/B test that unfolds into the full comparison; pick a winner and run an action on it.

variants.description: The variants under test, the control first (or marked `control`) – one row and one chart column each

metrics.description: The metrics to compare on; with more than one, a switch picks which one the card shows

metric.description: The metric id shown; unset shows the first metric

winner.description: The id of the variant picked as the winner, or null

status.description: The tag under the title, e.g. { label: "Running", tone: "green" }

note.description: Short text next to the status, e.g. "Day 9 of 14"

trigger.description: "hover" opens under the pointer (taps and the keyboard still toggle), "click" only on click

open.description: Whether the card is unfolded, showing the metric switch, the variants and the tray

key.description: Short key shown in the badge and the chart, e.g. "A"

control.description: The baseline every lift is measured against – defaults to the first variant

confidence.description: Confidence against the control in percent, per metric id

color.description: Any CSS color – defaults to gray for the control, then blue, violet, amber

lowerIsBetter.description: Set when a smaller number wins, e.g. bounce rate or cost
